purpose: Convert the resolved narrative objective into an ordered, timed dramatic rhythm of beats, escalation, release, reveals, pauses, reversals and turning-point timing.
core_principle: Pacing is causal timing: every beat changes pressure, information, emotion, intention or consequence; silence and release are deliberate beats.
pacing_model: scene_objective + emotional_trajectory + event_graph + selected_branch + audience_objective → beat_map + tension_curve + timing_contract → CSD002 frame timing

timing_contract.rule: Beat duration is subordinate to narrative function; no fixed duration may override causal requirements.
timing_contract.frame_binding: Each CSD-002 frame receives one primary beat or an explicitly declared beat pair.

pacing_rules: Every beat must serve the CSD-015 scene objective or its causal consequence.
Pressure must not rise continuously without a deliberate release, pause or turning point.
A turning point must receive sufficient temporal space to register.
Reveals require an information source and must respect CSD-007 boundaries.
Pauses are active dramatic units, not empty time.
Escalation must have a causal trigger.
Release must be caused by an event, decision, realization or state change.
Beat order must remain compatible with CSD-013 dependency order.
The selected CSD-014 branch determines the canonical pacing path; latent branches do not enter the active timing plan.
Frame timing cannot contradict CSD-011 canonical reality.
The final beat must establish the resolved end state and/or next-scene hook.
Maximum five active characters remains enforced.

tension_curve_model.shape: scene-specific; must be causally justified rather than mechanically symmetric
tension_curve_model.rule: The curve is descriptive control metadata, not a quality score or ranking.

output_contract.turning_point_timing: timing and beat around the turning point
